module.Title: Keep the Player Inside the Cave
module.Teaching: A boundary check prevents movement when the next position would leave the map.
module.PredictionExplanation: The check allows movement only while X is below the rightmost column.
module.DebugPrompt: The comparison points the wrong way. Movement is allowed while X is less than 9.
module.RecallPrompt: Write the right boundary check from memory. Use the exact identifier playerX. Use the exact value 9.
module.TransferPrompt: Prevent upward movement unless playerY is greater than zero. Use the exact value 0.
module.PreviewMessage: Movement now respects a map boundary.
